theme.description: Military-grade, highly secure, professional, and dense enterprise application. Designed for authority, clarity, and truth, leaning on tactical high-contrast to convey defense-grade trust.

mono.usage: Timestamps, employee IDs, audit logs, technical metadata

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Tight gap-4 or gap-6 for control room / admin dashboard layout
layout_and_spacing.containers: Rectangular, dense styles, max 4px to 8px border-radius (rounded-md). Avoid excessive rounded corners.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid borders everywhere to create a high-contrast 'technical' look. border-slate-200 in light, border-slate-800 in dark.

components.buttons: Shadcn standard. Square-ish (rounded-md). Primary is brand color (Slate 900 or Blue 600). Use subtle hover lifts (-translate-y-[1px]).
components.cards: Cardless or flat cards with 1px borders. No soft drop shadows. Use inner borders.
components.chat_interface: 3-pane layout: Sidebar (conversations), Main (chat history + input), Right panel (optional user profile/details).
components.message_bubbles: Subtle padding (p-3). Sent messages right-aligned, received left-aligned. Include timestamps and tick marks inside the bubble bottom-right corner.
components.inputs: Shadcn input. Clear focus rings (ring-blue-500) with 2px offset.
components.modals: Glassmorphism is BANNED for health/medical/military. Use flat solid backgrounds with sharp 1px borders.
components.tables: Dense. Small text (text-sm). Used for user directory and admin audit logs.
components.charts: Recharts / Shadcn Charts for Admin Dashboard (Analytics, storage usage, active users). Use strict colors.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit hover states on all interactables: hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white
motion_and_interactions.feedback: Use Sonner toasts for connection status, message delivery failures, and admin action confirmations.

icons.usage: Check (single tick), CheckCheck (double tick). Use CheckCheck with text-blue-500 for read receipt. Circle for online status (text-green-500).

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. E.g., data-testid='chat-send-button', data-testid='login-submit'

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Chivo and IBM Plex Sans.
Set up Tailwind CSS configuration with the exact custom colors specified above.
Implement standard Shadcn UI components but override border radii to 'rounded-md' (max 4-6px) for a sharper military feel.
Ensure the Chat UI feels similar to WhatsApp Web but with a darker, strictly professional 'Signal/Proton' theme.
Use grid borders for the Admin Dashboard to give it a 'Technical Control Room' look.
Implement Sonner toasts for all async actions.
Ensure all user interactions have 'data-testid' applied.
NO EMOJIS in the application as requested in the prompt.
